title: European Badger (Meles meles) (W1CDR0001490 BD4)
author: Aubrey John Williams / The British Library
changes: A European badger (Meles meles) calling with short grunts, recorded at Chobham Place, Surrey, England, on 24 February 1975. Trimmed to 3.40–6.30 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
